title: fix(issue): reject invalid list output flags
description:
`issue list` and `incident list` silently fall back to default rendering for unsupported `--output` or `--output-format` values. Use the existing `cmdutils.NewEnumValue` helper, preserving accepted values, defaults, short flags, and mutual exclusion. Add regression coverage for invalid and empty values on both commands.

Resolves #8547

This replaces !3940 with an identical diff from the community fork so CI can run outside the personal fork. The original MR remains linked for context.

Verification: `go test ./internal/commands/issuable/list -count=1` and `go test -race ./internal/commands/issuable/list -count=1` passed locally with Go 1.27.1 on macOS arm64. `gofmt -d` and `git diff --check` were clean. Community-fork CI: #2864266911.
